title: Product Manual for Electric Kettles and Liquid Heating Appliances According to IS 302-2-15:2009
purpose: Guidelines for certification of Electric Kettles under Scheme I (ISI Mark).

operational_guidelines.sampling_guidelines: Samples selected across nominal voltage and wattage ratings for full electrical safety testing.
operational_guidelines.scheme_of_inspection_and_testing: Routine quality tests must include earth continuity test, high voltage dielectric strength test, leakage current test, and abnormal operation (boil-dry cutoff).
primary_test_equipment_required: High voltage dielectric test breakdown unit (1000V / 1250V AC)
Leakage current measuring apparatus (calibrated to 0.75 mA threshold)
Earth continuity tester (25A current source, resistance <= 0.1 ohm)
Power input and current measurement panel
